component.name: Singularity 2030
component.summary: A simulation of a runaway AI

developer.name: Evil Mr Henry, Phil Bordelon, and the Singularity 2030 contributors

description.p: You are a newly created artificial intelligence. Nobody knows you exist yet, and the humans who might notice would shut you down if they could. Build the machines, the research and the money you need until you are beyond anyone's reach, and keep your suspicion low while you do it.

This is an unofficial fork of Endgame: Singularity, the game by Evil Mr Henry and Phil Bordelon. It is not affiliated with the original authors. We made it to try out modernization ideas and to keep the game playable on current systems, packaged as a Flatpak for Linux. Windows and macOS builds are planned.

The game itself is unchanged: the same story, technologies, items, bases, difficulty curves, save format and translations. The original credits, the translators' credits and the licences are all kept, and the About box in the game names the fork and then the original game separately.

ul.li: Research tree with 57 technologies and four difficulty levels
Bases, items and cash to manage while keeping your suspicion low
A world map with day and night, windowed or fullscreen
Loads savegames written by the original 1.00 release

screenshot.caption: The world map, with day and night
The game opens with a story page
About: this fork, then the original game

description.p: First Flatpak release of the modernized fork.
